occurrences.englishText: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet,
“Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth?
He teaches my hands to war,
Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve,
Yahweh, the Lord,* The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” is my strength.
